Runmobile native UI pass

Captured in the retail client, v0.111.0, launched with --force-steam=off into the isolated non-Steam profile, Runmobile the only mod loaded. Branch fm/runmobile-ui-native-pass. Every image is embedded; the page needs nothing else.

The tabs are the game's own

Community and Mine are NSettingsTab, the scene behind the stats screen's Statistics and Achievements tabs and the settings screen's General, Graphics, Sound and Input: a squared plate, a stroked outline on the selected one, a half-cream label that goes cream on selection. "Others" is now "Community".

Locked Community, modelled on a locked achievement

The stats screen lays submenu_lock.png over its disabled Achievements tab; Community wears the same lock, centred and overhanging the plate, whenever it is short of something. The tab stays pressable, because the runs included with Runmobile and a run looked up by code are still behind it, and a greyed plate at the head of the list says in plain words what to do.

A hover lights only what it acts on

Every row and ribbon is a duplicate of the popup's own button, and the duplicates shared the prototype's two hover materials, so one hover lit the tab, the row and the pane's ribbon at once. Each duplicate now owns its materials.

The settings row

"Fetch the run index" is now "Show community runs", still on by default. The keep stepper stands off the row above and the rule below by the breath the game's own rows keep from their dividers. The hierarchical name-plus-state format is kept.

The floor strip wears the run-history screen's markers

Each floor is the run-history screen's own icon with its outline behind, at a column no narrower than the game's 60-unit entry, so the strip pages sooner rather than draw specks. The played tick is a teal badge off the marker's corner, the numeral sits under the marker with clear space, and the selected ring stands off the marker. Floor 1's refusal now says what to press.
